benefits.name: Uniquely Uber
benefits.details: You’ll get Uber Ride and Eats credits every month, as well as on special occasions. Our offices always have meals and snacks available to everyone.

benefits.name: Out of Office
benefits.details: We provide generous paid vacation, sick leave, local holidays, and voting days off. Every employee gets a four-week sabbatical after every 5 years of service.

benefits.name: Health & Wellness
benefits.details: We want you to be happy and healthy in your mind and body. We offer comprehensive healthcare, monthly well-being reimbursements, and assistance programs that connect you to resources.

benefits.name: Family
benefits.details: You’ll never be asked to put work before family. With paid leave for parents, flexible work options, access to Cleo’s benefits program, and more, we make sure you’re able to take care of your family.

benefits.name: Finance
benefits.details: You’ll have access to our employee stock purchase plan, where you can set aside up to 15% of your eligible compensation. Equity awards and 401(k) plans for U.S. employees put you in the driver’s seat of your finances.
